metrics.name: meridian_ops_total
metrics.help: Reconciliation operations executed, by rule and op kind.

metrics.name: meridian_op_errors_total
metrics.help: Failed reconciliation operations, by rule, op kind, and error class.

metrics.name: meridian_fetch_errors_total
metrics.help: Failed calendar window fetches, by calendar and error class.

metrics.name: meridian_guard_triggers_total
metrics.help: Hardening guard triggers, by rule and guard.

metrics.name: meridian_last_successful_cycle_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: Unix time of the last fully successful cycle per rule (the alerting primitive).

metrics.name: meridian_shadow_drift
metrics.help: Shadows whose observed content hash differs from the marker hash (manual edits or provider normalization). Includes drift that gets auto-repaired this cycle — see meridian_shadow_drift_unrepairable for the alertable subset.

metrics.name: meridian_shadow_drift_unrepairable
metrics.help: Shadows still drifted after exhausting bounded repair retries — persistent hand-tamper or unstable provider normalization. The alertable subset of meridian_shadow_drift.
